rule: Agent-facing success, refusal, explain, provenance, receipt, and timeout surfaces expose no backend dialect, physical table, collection, index, shard, or native identifier.

setup.operationTemplate: {{surface}} under {{outcome}} with canaries injected into adapter metadata and backend errors

adversarialIntent: Seed recognizable physical names into every adapter diagnostic so accidental passthrough is caught byte-for-byte.

expansion.selection: One nextU32 per dimension in listed order; select values[word % values.length].

checks: No binding canary appears in any agent-facing byte stream.
Logical catalog ids and stable error codes remain available where required.
Opaque receipt tokens do not decode or pattern-match to canaries.
Operator-only diagnostics cannot be routed into model context.
